english: Huh?
What's wrong?\nYou're in such a hurry.
N-nothing at all.\nAhaha...
Come to think of it, did you see Twin Angel\naround here just now?
Gah! I-I didn't see them.
Probably just your imagination~.\nYeah, that must be it!
B-besides, I heard they've had\nlots of missions lately and they're busy,\nso they probably wouldn't be around here?
I see...\nI wanted to thank them sometime.
Th-thanks!?\nThen I'd want striped pa— I mean!
Twin Angel are heroes of justice,\nso I don't think they'd want anything in return!
Yeah, that's right!\nThey probably don't need thanks!
So don't even think about it anymore...\nokay?
Then... just pass along my thanks.
Yeah, of course!
Still,\nwhere does Twin Angel come from?
Huh? W-well...\nI don't really know either...\nBut why do you ask?
No reason, I've just always wondered...
Yeah yeah, I get it~~.
But I think it's better\nnot to know that kind of thing —\nkeeps the mystery alive, right?
I was wondering if they have a home or something.
A home!? W-well~~\nA hero of justice's house...\nMight be closer than you think...
But who knows!?\nMaybe they came from another planet!\n...Just kidding... ahaha...
I still want to know...\nCan you summon them here?
Huh!? Here?\nTh-that's a bit...
If they transformed someplace like this,\nthey'd be fou— Uwaaah! I mean!
Um, uh, that... right!\nThey just went on a mission,\nso they're probably tired~~?
Calling them when there's no trouble\nwould be a bother, right~~? Right??
Too bad, but you're right, Haruka-san.\nSorry about that.
Y-yeah. Sorry.
But next time I see them, I'll definitely tell them\nyou were grateful!!
Yes, please.
Phew~~. That was close...
But it doesn't look like anyone knows\nI transform.\nIs that thanks to the Holy Grail fragments too?
Anyway, that was close,\nbut I've got to be careful from now on!
Haruka-san, um...\nAbout what we talked about before...
Huh? Wh-what about?
About Twin Angel...?\nAre you still curious?
B-but I don't think\nthere's much I can answer~~...
Then just one thing.\nWhy is Twin Angel so strong?
Huh, are they that strong?\nHmm, I wonder why...
The reason for their strength...\nBecause they're heroes of justice, yeah!!
Is that really all?
That's definitely it!\nIf they were weak they couldn't be heroes of justice...
Oh, and maybe\nbecause there are two of them!?
The two of them are in perfect sync,\nso they're probably putting out many times the power!
True... now that you mention it.\nIt'd be weird if they were secretly going to the gym.
Huh, jam? Come to think of it, I'm hungry~~\nI want striped panties with jam\nand condensed milk...
No.\nGym. Gym.
Huh, gym? The exercise kind?\nAhaha, I thought that was weird~.
Maybe they train\nat places like that!
Huh!? Didn't you just say 'jam'?\nDid I hear wrong?
I was hungry, so it just slipped out...\nRed Angel probably likes strawberry jam~~,\nyeah!!
Well, that's about it.\nDid you get the gist?
Mostly...\nBut I get that Twin Angel is amazing.
Ehehe...\nbeing praised like that is embarrassing~~.
Hm? I wasn't talking about you, Haruka-san?
Huh!? O-oh, right, of course!?\nI just thought maybe you were~!
See, I'm always the one who calls them,\nso it feels like it's about me...
Yeah, that must be it. That's what it is!!
N-next time I see Twin Angel,\nI'll tell them you praised them.
Yes, please!\nSee you later.
That was close...
Hey hey,\nis there a pool around here?
A pool?\nI don't think there is...\nWhy?
I suddenly felt like swimming...
I love swimming!\nI'm on the swim team at the academy too.
I wish all my classes were swimming~~,\nthat's how much!
My best stroke is the crawl!\nI can even swim with my face up!
Hey, do you like swimming?
I like it enough\nthat I'd be fine with swim class every day!
I'm always racing everyone on the team.\nHey, let's swim together sometime!
I wonder who's faster?\nUuugh~~, can't wait~~!
I'll pass.\nI'm probably not as good as you, Haruka-san.
Oh, but do you have a swimsuit?
A swimsuit?
Yeah, you need a swimsuit to swim.
Boys' swimsuits come in all kinds these days.\nLike this!
Ta-daa! Striped swimsuit!\nThe stripe colors, the stripe ratio — perfect!
But even I can't wear a boy's swimsuit...\nHow about it?\nWant to try it on?
Wh-why are you pushing stripes so hard?
Stripes are cute!\nStaring at them makes me happy~~.
Stripes make anything about 50% cuter,\nbut especially...\npanties...
U-uh...
Striped panties are great...
I want to collect striped panties from all over the world\nand open a Striped Panty Museum...
Yeah... I guess.
I knew it!?\nYeah yeah, you get it~~!
Striped panties should catch on\nwith boys too!!
Ah! S-sorry!?\nTalking about this with a boy...
You're easy to talk to,\nso I got carried away.
But if you ever notice\nthe charm of stripes, I'd be happy.\nSee you later!
Haruka-san really gets fired up about striped panties...
Uuugh, I'm huuungry.
Hm? Haruka-san? Heeey!
Ah, morning!
'Morning'? It's already this late?
Ehehe, I overslept...
Aoi-chan usually wakes me up,\nbut...
Today Aoi-chan had something to do\nand wasn't around.
Well, we're not going to school\nright now anyway, so it's fine.
She always wakes you up?
Yeah!\nAoi-chan is a super early riser.
I tell myself I've got to get up on my own,\nbut I end up feeling safe and...
Aren't you barely on time every day?
Yeah, I am~~.\nSo I always end up running to school...
I feel bad making\neven early-rising Aoi-chan run, but...
You two really are close.
Yeah! Aoi-chan's kind, good at studying,\ngraceful...
And, well, she's got a big chest too...\nuuugh, total opposite of me.
Her only flaw is loving spicy food a bit too much?\nJust watching Aoi-chan's curry from next to her\nmakes my eyes sting~~.
Hm? What's wrong?\nWhy are you staring...
No, I just thought you looked really happy.
R-really?\nSpicy stuff's not really my thing...
No, I mean you look really happy\nwhen you talk about Aoi-san.
Oh, that?\nEhehe, did I really look that happy?
I'm always with Aoi-chan, after all.
And Aoi-chan was\nmy first-ever friend...
She's special.\nLike family, almost.
I'd be happy\nif I could always be with Aoi-chan...
Ehehe, my stomach growled.\nSorry, I'm going to buy some food —\nsee ya.
Her first friend... huh.
Sigh...
What's wrong?\nYou look down.
Haruka-san...
Ahh, did you drop\nthe anpan you were saving\non the ground or something?
Or did you forget your bento\nor something...?
Then let's trade side dishes!\nAh, but if you forgot it, there's nothing to trade.
That's not it.\nAnd why is it always about food?
Huh, no?\nThen did someone steal\nyour favorite panties...?
That'd be shocking~~. But cheer up!\nAt times like that, these striped pa—
No! Sigh...\nSeeing your smile made me completely\nforget the bad stuff.
Huh, really?\nThat's great~~!
Your friendliness and energy\nalways surprise me, Haruka-san.
R-really? People always say energy's\nmy only good trait...
Oh, but I wasn't always like that.
Um, well.\nIt might not be a fun story, but...
When I was little,\nI lost my parents in an accident.
I was really down back then,\nshut myself away...
Ah, sorry!?\nFor suddenly telling you this.
But Aoi-chan saved me\nfrom that.
Ahaha, maybe I overcorrected\nand got too energetic?\nJust kidding...
That happened...?\nI'm sorry.
No, it's not your fault.
And now I want to help\npeople who feel lonely~~...\nor so I hope!!
That's admirable!
S-saying that makes me\nblush~~.
But I've still got a long way to go!\nI've got to try even harder!
So that's why you... me...
Huh? Oh, no, that was...\nI really thought you were just\nhungry back then...
But if it cheered you up,\nall's well that ends well, right? Ehehe.
I should learn from you...
Ehehe,\nI haven't done anything worth praising.
It's still amazing.
Ehehe, thanks.
(My view of Haruka-san has changed...)
Hey hey, got a minute?
Actually, I was thinking\nwe should all do something together sometime...
It'd bring everyone closer,\nand it sounds fun, right?
So we decided\nto do something in Dokoka Town.
I suggested a striped-panty café,\nbut it got shot down\ninstantly...
So in the end, nothing's decided.\nWhat do I dooo.
Hmm, let me think...
If nobody has a better idea,\na striped-panty café would be fine~~...
Huh... but wait,\nwhat even is a striped-panty café...?
Doing something together as a group is a good idea,\nso let's think of something else.
Yeah. But what do we do~~?\nI can't think of anything~~.
Don't overthink it —\nhow about just a normal party?
A party...? Yeah, maybe!\nIt's normal, but I never would've thought of it~~.
You're the organizer, Haruka-san?
Yeah.\nKurumi-chan was going to do it, actually.
She looked busy,\nso I volunteered~~.
Is anyone helping you?
Just me this time.\nEveryone looked busy,\nso I said I'd do it alone!
But I'll give it my all alone!\nI'll hype it up to the max~~!!
Still, why was everyone\nso busy~~?
I think it was something like... teiki-kenshin?\nThey just did one not long ago, I thought.
Aoi-chan even asked me if my studying was okay~~,\nI wonder what that was about...?
You mean regular exams...?
Huh? Regu...lar... ex-ams...?
Th-that's what it was~~!?\nUuugh, I thought something was off.
Wh-wh-what do I do,\nI'll fail if I'm busy with party prep.\nI'm barely passing as it is...
But I said I'd do it,\nso I've got to try!\nCould you help me out a little...?
Of course.\nMy exams are done, so I'll help.
Yay!\nWhat a relief.
I'll think of some other ideas too.
Yeah, thanks.\nI'll let you know when we decide anything—!
What kind of party will it be...?\nI'm nervous, but kind of looking forward to it.
Hey, Haruka-san.
What's up?
About the party the other day...
That's all set!\nEverything's ready!
Ah, I'm studying for exams properly too.\nAoi-chan's helping me!
When I told Aoi-chan, she said she'd help\nwith studying AND party prep...
So the two of us\nhave prep covered!
Are you sure without me?
Yeah. Once everyone talked it over,\nit went super smoothly.
So it's fine!\nThanks so much, really.
Everyone's helping too?
Yeah! Everyone's busy with exams, though —\nI hope it's okay?
...not that I can talk.\nAhaha...
So what's the party\ngoing to be like?
Huh?\nTh-that's... still a secret.
I could tell you, but I think it's better\nto save the surprise~~.
A hint... ehehe.\nI think you'll love it!
It'll make your heart skip a beat, for sure!\nNo more — it's a secret!
(Heart-skipping!? But that means...\nthis and that...)
Hm? What's wrong?
Huh? Wh-what!?\nN-nothing.
Ahaha, are you nervous, maybe?
But really,\nhaving you around helped so much~~.
Not just this time.\nUntil now I've talked to Aoi-chan\nabout everything, but...
I end up relying on her too much.\nI'm glad I made another friend I can talk to.
Friends... right? Us...?\nHuh, this feels weird... my chest...
Ahaha, like your heart skipping a beat?
Heart skipping...\nyeah. Maybe...
(Huh!? I meant it as a joke.\nCould that mean...!?)
I... want to know more\nabout you...
H-huh!?
Play together more, have fun together...\nI want to make you happy...
A-ah? What am I saying.\nSorry, suddenly — see ya!!
Haruka-san... does that mean me!?
Ah! I've been waiting!\nHere! Hurry inside.
H-huhhh?\nInside... what do you mean?
Wait a bit, okay?\nYou came sooner than I thought,\nso I'm not ready yet~~.
Ehehe,\nI hope you'll like it...
Ehehe... how is it?\nIs it weird...?
It's my party outfit.\nKind of embarrassing, but...
I-I see... wait, where is everyone!?\nJust the two of us!?
Y-yeah. I wanted only you to see it...
It's a secret from everyone, okay?\nPromise...?
I've been looking forward to today for sooo long...
Ah... sorry I'm getting\nall worked up by myself?
N-no, not at all...
(Could this be going where I think...)
What's wrong? You're grinning~~?
Y-you're not thinking\nweird things... are you?
Ahh, I'm getting embarrassed~~!\nI-I'll go make some tea!!
Kyaaa—!!
A-are you okay!?
Y-yeah, I'm fine...\ns-sorry.
Ah, right...\nI totally forgot, but...
Here. This is your costume.
Wearing it alone is embarrassing... what do you think?
You mean... I should wear it too?
Yeah! It'll be fun if we both wear them~~!
I didn't know what you'd like, but...
Is this style okay?
(So when she said she wanted to know more about me,\nTHIS is what she meant!?)
A-and~~ of course, THIS too!!\nStriped panties for men—!!☆
Come on~~, don't be shy,\ntry them on~~!!
Wh-whaa—!!\nStop—!!
...Hm? Mmm... huh?
A-are you okay?\nYou were really tossing and turning...
You were shouting in your sleep.\n'Stop—!'...
What kind of scary dream was it...?\nGhosts? Zombies?
N-no, not that.
Good thing it was a dream!\nOh, everyone already went ahead.\nHurry, hurry!
Here, don't forget this.\nI think we'll use it at today's party.
Huh? Is this... striped panties?
Yeah! They're properly for boys, so don't worry!\nOh, putting them on already??
Whaa—!!\nStop—!!
